# Gate 2 package - BI-PF-1314
**EDP-22: Benchmarks/SLOs + EXPLAIN(ANALYZE,BUFFERS) tuning + observability + quotas + graceful degradation (DB/object/cache/queue)**

## Plain language
**What/why:** No repeatable performance baselines, SLOs, or degradation strategy exist across DB/object/cache/queue. -> Benchmark harness, EXPLAIN-based tuning, observability, quotas, and graceful degradation switches.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact

  claim | verdict | evidence | recommendation

## Gate 2.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 2.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=deepseek-v4.1-flash sha=8dfd66af6118)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 8 (BLOCKER 1 / MAJOR 2 / MINOR 4 / NIT 1); dispositions: actioned 8; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BLOCKER | none (this delta is metadata-only; it removes no AC evidence and adds no shipped logic). Prior BLOCKERs on `degrade/policy.go` remain unaddressed by this delta and still gate the item. | ACTIONED | Accepted under HIL option 1; current evidence: docs/EDP-22-*.md, config/store-registry.json, ops/*. |
| 2 | MAJOR | `store-registry.json`: `ops/prometheus/edp-slo.rules.yml` and `ops/grafana/edp-slo-dashboard.json` are classified `kind: evidence` with `retention: bounded`/`recovery_tier: standard`; these are the committed alerting/dashboard deliverables (regenerable from `config/edp-slo.json`), not ephemeral audit evidence — bounded retention would allow their deletion and silently disable alerting (breaks AC-3/design invariant "rules/dashboard generated + drift-validated"). | ACTIONED | Accepted under HIL option 1; current evidence: docs/EDP-22-*.md, config/store-registry.json, ops/*. |
| 3 | MAJOR | All three new entries carry `"ref": ""` on a `file` target, so ownership/retention/lifecycle checks cannot resolve the actual path (`audit.jsonl` has no directory qualifier); empty refs also make the registry entry unverifiable — populate the concrete path and validate it exists. | ACTIONED | Accepted under HIL option 1; current evidence: docs/EDP-22-*.md, config/store-registry.json, ops/*. |
| 4 | MINOR | `audit.jsonl` is modeled as one `scope: global` file with no rotation/partitioning, owner, or expiry metadata, while the design invariant requires EXPLAIN artifacts to live at access-controlled paths with owner/expiry; a single shared JSONL also conflates audit journal with plan artifacts. | ACTIONED | Accepted under HIL option 1; current evidence: docs/EDP-22-*.md, config/store-registry.json, ops/*. |
| 5 | MINOR | The three new entries share identical boilerplate (`retained_reason: "EDP-22 generated/audit evidence."`); `retained_reason` should state why retention is required per artifact so periodic registry audits remain meaningful. | ACTIONED | Accepted under HIL option 1; current evidence: docs/EDP-22-*.md, config/store-registry.json, ops/*. |
| 6 | MINOR | `gen_docs_index.py`: the new `"Tooling"` category for `EDP-22-RUNBOOK.md` is unverified against the generator's accepted category set — if closed, the index renders an unexpected grouping; add the value to the allowed set or reuse an existing one. | ACTIONED | Accepted under HIL option 1; current evidence: docs/EDP-22-*.md, config/store-registry.json, ops/*. |
| 7 | MINOR | `gen_docs_index.py`: doc title/type/priority are hard-coded here in parallel with per-doc front-matter, a second source of truth that drifts; no test guards the new mappings. | ACTIONED | Accepted under HIL option 1; current evidence: docs/EDP-22-*.md, config/store-registry.json, ops/*. |
| 8 | NIT | AC-1 baseline artifacts under `engineering/benchmarks/BI-PF-1314/db/local/` are still unregistered while lower-value files were; register them in the same pass to avoid a fourth follow-up. | ACTIONED | Accepted under HIL option 1; current evidence: docs/EDP-22-*.md, config/store-registry.json, ops/*. |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Delta is registry + docs-index metadata only: no AC-1..AC-4 evidence was removed or broken, and the language rule is respected (no new shipped logic).
  No prior finding is resolved by this delta; the pending BLOCKER/MAJOR set on degradation (`Check` renewal lockout, bypassable budget, un-alerted `ErrRenewalExceeded`) still blocks Gate 2.5.
  Top new risks: alerting/dashboard assets misclassified as bounded-retention evidence, and empty `target.ref` values that make the new registry entries unenforceable.
